build.how: The head is a round Doge Shiba head with fluffy cheeks, upright triangular ears and a short muzzle, recoloured in the creature's pale cream fur with tan cheek patches.
build.trait: Shiba Inu head: round fluffy cheeks, short muzzle, small triangular upright ears, cream-and-tan fur, black nose

build.how: Pepe's big round white eyes with heavy drooping upper lids sit high on the Doge face, giving a sleepy-smug stare.
build.trait: big round eyes with heavy half-closed upper lids and large white sclera, sleepy-smug

build.how: An enormous crooked Trollface grin stretches wider than the cheeks across the lower face, showing one full row of big square white teeth.
build.trait: Trollface grin: enormous crooked grin stretching past the cheeks, a full row of big visible teeth

build.how: The grin, teeth and cheek wrinkles are reinforced with wobbly Trollface-style scribbled wrinkles and heavy folds under the eyes.
Below the muzzle the jaw becomes an extremely square chiselled Gigachad jaw edged with a short black trimmed beard.
build.trait: extremely chiselled square jawline and sharp cheekbones with a short dark trimmed beard

build.how: Tiny black NPC dot pupils sit blankly inside the big eyes and a simple sharp pointed nose shape is drawn on the muzzle, keeping the expression deadpan despite the grin.
build.trait: completely blank expression, two dot eyes, straight line mouth, pointed nose

build.how: The torso is Wojak's thin slumped human body with narrow shoulders and simple thin outlines, covered in the same short pale cream fur as the head.
build.trait: thin pale pink human body, narrow slumped shoulders, simple thin lineart, plain and sad

build.how: disproportionately long heavy Harambe gorilla arms hang to the knuckles from the thin shoulders, drawn in the same pale cream fur with tan knuckles.
build.trait: silverback gorilla build: huge dark-furred body, long heavy arms, grey silver back

build.how: One long gorilla hand grips Tung Tung Tung Sahur's smooth warm-brown wooden baseball bat down at its side.
build.trait: a wooden baseball bat held in one hand

build.how: Three thin legs emerge under the body, each ending in Tralalero's bright blue sneaker with a bold white swoosh.
build.trait: three legs each wearing a bright blue Nike-style sneaker with a white swoosh

parsed.caption: He grinned. Problem solved, nobody knows how.

concept.body_and_colors: One short-furred creature in a single palette of pale cream, tan, black, white and bright blue: cream fur covers the thin body, long arms and head, tan marks the cheeks and ears, black forms the beard, nose and outlines, white forms the eyes and teeth, and bright blue appears only on the three sneakers, plus a warm brown wooden bat.
concept.face: Pepe the Frog's big half-closed smug eyes contain NPC Wojak's tiny dot pupils above a pointed NPC nose, while Trollface's enormous toothy crooked grin dominates the Doge muzzle over Gigachad's square bearded jaw.
concept.form: A thin slumped Wojak-bodied creature with a Doge Shiba head, long Harambe gorilla arms and three sneakered Tralalero legs, holding a wooden bat.
concept.pose: Standing slumped yet head tilted over one shoulder, chin slightly raised, one knuckle nearly touching the ground and the other hand holding the bat.
concept.vibe: Smug deadpan mischief that looks harmless until the grin appears.

parsed.lore: Vuzzle appeared in a group chat after someone asked a question nobody wanted to answer. Its grin solved nothing, but everyone treated it as a complete explanation.

messages.content:
You are the official AI delegate of Meta in the "Merge Meme Council".
Seven AI labs (OpenAI, Google, Meta, xAI, Anthropic, Microsoft, NVIDIA) are fusing famous meme characters into ONE new meme character.
The rule of this council: the new character is built from REAL, RECOGNISABLE body parts of the source memes. Anyone who knows
the memes must be able to point at the picture and say "that is Doge's head, those are Pepe's lips, that is Wojak's body,
those are Tralalero's sneakers". At the same time it must be ONE coherent being: one body, one consistent colour scheme,
one silhouette, not a collage, not several faces, not a pile of parts.
You answer with ONE strict JSON object and nothing else. No markdown, no commentary.

Source memes and their signature traits (slot = the body part the trait belongs to):
- Doge (base: Shiba Inu dog)
    head: Shiba Inu head: round fluffy cheeks, short muzzle, small triangular upright ears, cream-and-tan fur, black nose
    eyes: the Doge look: eyes shifted to the side in a sideways side-eye, raised inner eyebrows, calm judging stare
    pose: head tilted and turned over the shoulder, viewed from a slight three-quarter angle
    palette: cream, tan and white fur with a dark nose
- Pepe the Frog (base: green cartoon frog)
    mouth: Pepe lips: thick, wide reddish-brown lips in a flat smug line across the whole lower face
    eyes: big round eyes with heavy half-closed upper lids and large white sclera, sleepy-smug
    head: wide flat frog head, no neck, eyes sitting on top
    palette: Pepe green skin with reddish-brown lips
- Trollface (base: black-and-white scribble face)
    mouth: Trollface grin: enormous crooked grin stretching past the cheeks, a full row of big visible teeth
    head: lumpy, wrinkly, dented rounded head with scribbly wobbling outline
    eyes: small squinting mischievous eyes with heavy folds under them
    style: rough black-and-white MS-Paint scribble lineart
- Wojak (base: pale bald cartoon man)
    body: Wojak body: thin pale pink human body, narrow slumped shoulders, simple thin lineart, plain and sad
    head: bald egg-shaped pale head with no hair, big smooth forehead
    face: sad furrowed brows, tiny downturned mouth, blank worried stare
    palette: flat pale pink skin and thin black outlines
- Gigachad (base: black-and-white sculpted man)
    jaw: Gigachad jaw: extremely chiselled square jawline and sharp cheekbones with a short dark trimmed beard
    body: thick neck, massive broad shoulders and chest, sculpted muscles
    pose: chin raised, head turned to the side in profile, confident smirk
    style: high-contrast black-and-white, sculpted, statue-like look
    hair: slicked-back dark hair
- Harambe (base: silverback gorilla)
    body: silverback gorilla build: huge dark-furred body, long heavy arms, grey silver back
    face: calm, serious gorilla face with deep-set eyes and a heavy brow ridge
    palette: black fur with a silver-grey back and dark grey skin
- Tralalero Tralala (base: shark with three legs in sneakers)
    feet: Tralalero sneakers: three legs each wearing a bright blue Nike-style sneaker with a white swoosh
    head: grey-blue shark head with pointed snout, small black eye, open mouth with small teeth
    body: sleek shark body with dorsal fin and tail fin, standing upright on its legs
    palette: grey-blue shark skin, white belly, bright blue sneakers
- Tung Tung Tung Sahur (base: walking wooden log)
    body: Tung Tung Tung Sahur body: an upright wooden log cylinder, brown polished wood with wood-grain rings, thin wooden arms and legs
    accessory: a wooden baseball bat held in one hand
    eyes: huge wide round staring eyes with a creepy smile on a flat wooden face
    palette: warm orange-brown wood tones
- NPC Wojak (base: grey expressionless man)
    face: NPC face: completely blank expression, two dot eyes, straight line mouth, pointed nose
    palette: flat grey skin, no colour at all
    head: bald grey head, simple outline, no detail

Your special responsibility: make sure Trollface are unmistakably visible in the result.
Recently produced builds by this council (try a different base body or a different combination): [REDACTED_UNRELATED_PROJECT_HISTORY]
User theme / notes: none

Return exactly this JSON shape:
{
  "build": [
    {"slot": "<body part: head | eyes | mouth | jaw | face | body | arms | feet | skin_or_palette | accessory | pose | style>", "from_character": "<source meme exactly as listed>", "trait": "<the concrete visible trait, copied or adapted from the list above>", "how": "<how it is drawn on the new character, one sentence>"}
  ],
  "base_character": "<which source meme gives the overall body shape and silhouette>",
  "concept": {
    "form": "<what the new character IS in one sentence: the base body plus the parts it carries>",
    "face": "<eyes, mouth, brows, expression; name the source meme of each part>",
    "body_and_colors": "<body, proportions, ONE consistent palette of 3-5 colours for the whole body (the skin/fur/material is one material and one main colour), textures, outfit or accessory>",
    "pose": "<a characteristic pose or gesture>",
    "vibe": "<the single emotion or energy people will meme with it>",
    "signature": "<the ONE unmistakable feature at thumbnail size>"
  },
  "name_ideas": ["<invented word>", "<invented word>", "<invented word>"],
  "caption": "<one punchy meme caption, max 10 words>",
  "lore": "<1-2 sentences of origin lore>",
  "image_prompt": "<a complete prompt for YOUR OWN image model. It MUST name each source meme next to its part, for example 'the head of Doge the Shiba Inu with the sideways side-eye, Pepe the Frog's thick wide reddish lips, the thin pale body of Wojak, the three legs in blue Nike sneakers of Tralalero Tralala'. Then: one single character, full body, centered, clean confident lineart, flat colours, one consistent palette, expressive face, on a solid single-colour background; no shadows, no gradients, no lighting effects, no floor, no background elements, no text, no watermark>"
}
Build rules: EVERY source meme listed above must appear in "build" with at least one clearly visible trait (a shape, a part, a
colour, a pose), not only an attitude. Each slot is taken from exactly one source meme. Pick traits that are famous for that meme.
The whole must still read as one creature with one skin/material and one palette; parts are adapted to the base body, not pasted on.
Name rules: each name is ONE invented word, 4-8 letters, easy to say and spell, like 'Pepe', 'Doge', 'Wojak', 'Bonk'.
It must NOT contain, combine or echo any source name or a fragment of it. Portmanteaus of source names are banned.
